name: BRIO / S-DML Abstractive Summarization
desc: Three-stage monolingual abstractive summarization pipeline on a BART backbone: MLE warm-up fine-tuning, diverse beam-search candidate generation, and contrastive preference optimization (BRIO). Researched a Semantic-Driven Dynamic Margin Loss (S-DML) that scales the ranking margin using cosine similarity between candidate embeddings.

name: OSINT Intelligence Dashboard
desc: Full-stack OSINT dashboard integrating 15+ APIs across 7 intelligence categories, automating IP and domain analysis for cybersecurity threat assessment. Built a consensus engine that normalizes multi-source JSON into a unified schema and resolves conflicts algorithmically.

name: FabriScan AI — Multi-Task Textile Analysis
desc: Multi-task learning architecture on a shared Xception backbone that simultaneously classifies garments (14 categories) and regresses fabric composition. A dual-head output with KL-divergence loss predicts blend percentage distributions, with Grad-CAM used to verify the model attends to weave patterns rather than background.

name: AI Surveillance System
desc: Real-time surveillance suite combining YOLOv8 object detection with a multi-threaded, queue-buffered webcam stream. Includes an LBPH facial recognition pipeline, a CNN-based affective computing layer for emotion classification, and a safety-critical detector for weapons (knives, guns, scissors).
